# SchemaFirst

> SchemaFirst (`schemafirst`) is an offline, read-only pre-migration database profiler and schema audit generator. It checks for replication and encoding blockers, unmasked personal data in free text, orphan foreign keys, and type/format issues, and compiles dbt staging models without exporting raw cell values.

## Live Demo
- [Schema Audit Report](https://schemafirst.parkanore.com/): Zero-dependency HTML schema audit generated from a synthetic local council SQLite database.
- [Structured Profile JSON](https://schemafirst.parkanore.com/profile.json): Machine-readable audit telemetry and table/column flaw inventory.

## Audit Sections
- Section 1 — Replication & Encoding: Missing primary keys, PostgreSQL NUL byte poison (`0x00`), and CP1252 encoding issues.
- Section 2 — Unmasked Personal Data: Unstructured text columns matching UK NINO, NHS number, or redaction marker patterns.
- Section 3 — Topology & Foreign Keys: Topological load order, Mermaid dependency graph, declared/inferred FK edges, and orphan counts.
- Section 4 — Table Profiles & dbt Models: Column-level type recommendations, null/distinct rates, remediation expressions, and generated `stg_*.sql` models.
